# m.partners.benzinga.earnings

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Earnings announcements of US companies from Benzinga, with estimates and surprises.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.partners.benzinga.earnings(symbols=None, *, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `BenzingaId`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | US stock tickers. Leave it out for every ticker; `dm.ALL` is refused. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | Any field of the rows, such as `"date"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. A watchlist's `fetch()` caps every request instead. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters, such as `{"importance_gte": 3}`. ## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The row's instrument, as Massive's ticker. From REST `ticker`: "The stock symbol of the company reporting earnings." |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose symbol the library can't read. That row's `Symbol` is null. Null on every other row. When `MassiveConfig.unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, such a row fails the table instead, and the column is absent. |
| `ActualEps` | double | The actual earnings per share (EPS) reported by the company for the given period. |
| `ActualRevenue` | double | The actual revenue reported by the company for the given fiscal period. |
| `BenzingaId` | String | The identifier used by Benzinga for this record. |
| `CompanyName` | String | The name of the company releasing earnings. |
| `Currency` | String | The ISO 4217 currency code indicating the denomination in which the figures are reported. |
| `Date` | String | The calendar date (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD) when the earnings are scheduled or were reported. |
| `DateStatus` | String | Indicates whether the date of the earnings report has been confirmed. Possible values include: projected, confirmed. |
| `EpsMethod` | String | The methodology of the EPS figure. Possible values are gaap (standardized financials under Generally Accepted Accounting Principles), ffo (Funds From Operations, a non-GAAP metric commonly used to assess the operating performance of REITs), and adj (adjusted, non-GAAP). |
| `EpsSurprise` | double | The difference between the actual and estimated EPS. |
| `EpsSurprisePercent` | double | The EPS surprise relative to the estimate, as a decimal fraction (0.75 = 75%), calculated as eps_surprise divided by the absolute value of estimated_eps. Positive is a beat and negative a miss, even when the estimate is negative. When the estimate is 0 the value is 1 or -1, and estimates near 0 give very large values. |
| `EstimatedEps` | double | The analyst consensus estimate for earnings per share (EPS) for the given period. |
| `EstimatedRevenue` | double | The analyst consensus estimate for the company's revenue in the given period. |
| `FiscalPeriod` | String | The fiscal period for which the earnings are reported. Examples include: Q1, Q2, H1, FY. |
| `FiscalYear` | long | The fiscal year in which the earnings period falls. |
| `Importance` | long | A subjective indicator of the importance of the event, on a scale from 0 (lowest) to 5 (highest). |
| `LastUpdated` | Instant | The timestamp (formatted as an ISO 8601 timestamp) when the record was last updated in the system. |
| `Notes` | String | Additional context, commentary, or clarifying notes related to the earnings event. |
| `PreviousEps` | double | The company's reported earnings per share (EPS) for the previous comparable period. |
| `PreviousRevenue` | double | The company's revenue for the previous comparable fiscal period. |
| `RevenueMethod` | String | The methodology of the revenue figure. Possible values are gaap (standardized financials under Generally Accepted Accounting Principles), adj (adjusted, non-GAAP figures that exclude certain items like one-time charges or divestitures), and rental (revenue specifically derived from rental operations, typically used by REITs, leasing companies, or businesses with a rental-based model). |
| `RevenueSurprise` | double | The difference between the actual and estimated revenue. |
| `RevenueSurprisePercent` | double | The revenue surprise relative to the estimate, as a decimal fraction (0.126 = 12.6%), calculated as revenue_surprise divided by the absolute value of estimated_revenue. Positive is a beat and negative a miss. |
| `Time` | String | The time (formatted as 24-hour HH:MM:SS EST) when the earnings are scheduled or were reported. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
